ablations.name: Full Feature Model (Benchmark)
ablations.business_impact: Captures promotional surges, payday quincenas, and multi-scale momentum.

ablations.name: Ablation 1: Exclude Promotional Features
ablations.business_impact: Causes severe underforecasting during trade promotion weeks (+545% actual lift in EDA missed).

ablations.name: Ablation 2: Exclude Calendar & Payday Cycles
ablations.features_removed: quincena_flag, month_start_flag, month_end_flag, is_holiday_week, holidays_in_week, week_of_year, month, quarter
ablations.business_impact: Misses 15th and month-end salary payout surges; leads to recurring mid-month stockouts.

ablations.name: Ablation 3: Exclude Macroeconomic & Traffic
ablations.business_impact: Minor macro drift. Store-level customer transactions and oil prices act as weak broad indicators.

ablations.name: Ablation 4: Simple Lags Only (No Rolling Stats)
ablations.business_impact: Drastic variance explosion. Without multi-scale rolling means, models overfit to single-week noise.
